title: Towards a new PGD strategy for the simulation of slender structures
summary: Effective models for slender structures derived from well-known plate (or shell) theories are justified within the limit of a small thickness, and may therefore prove limited for intermediate slenderness. On the other hand, direct 3D simulation of such structures is sub-optimal because it does not take advantage of the presence of small dimensions in some directions and is sometimes too costly and ill-conditioned.
